CustomField.formula: IF( OR( AND(ISPICKVAL(Buy_Currency__c, "HKD"), BLANKVALUE(Buy_FX_Rate__c, 0) <= 0), AND(ISPICKVAL(Sell_Currency__c, "HKD"), BLANKVALUE(Sell_FX_Rate__c, 0) <= 0) ), NULL, IF(ISPICKVAL(Sell_Currency__c, "HKD"), BLANKVALUE(Sell_HKD_Unit_Price__c, 0) / Sell_FX_Rate__c, BLANKVALUE(Sell_USD_Unit_Price_Precise__c, BLANKVALUE(UnitPrice, 0))) - BLANKVALUE(Buyer_Broker_Commission__c, 0) - IF(ISPICKVAL(Buy_Currency__c, "HKD"), BLANKVALUE(Buy_HKD_Unit_Price__c, 0) / Buy_FX_Rate__c, BLANKVALUE(Buy_USD_Unit_Price_Precise__c, BLANKVALUE(Supplier_Unit_Price__c, 0))) - BLANKVALUE(Supplier_Broker_Commission__c, 0) )
CustomField.label: Internal Margin
